missing_information_behavior: If any required safety or context information is missing, do not add positive recommendation score; request clarification or escalate.
safety_exclusions: Never recommend iron based on fatigue alone; assess labs and other causes; avoid duplicate iron and iron overload.
professional_escalation_conditions: Anemia symptoms, bleeding, pregnancy, chronic disease, hemochromatosis or abnormal labs require clinical evaluation.
population_and_context: Adults reporting fatigue; fatigue is nonspecific and must not be treated as evidence of iron deficiency.
dose_constraints: No dose; iron treatment should follow diagnosis and clinician advice.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Iron fact sheet; dietary reference data do not diagnose iron deficiency. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
